-- Rein lesende Grundlage fuer die spaetere Tarifpflege.
-- Jeder Trainer wird je Gesamtangebot genau einmal gezaehlt.
-- Bei Mehrfachzuweisungen ist der Erloes je Trainer nur ein Kontextwert und nicht addierbar.
WITH produktiv AS (
    SELECT t.offer_id, t.kurscode, t.kursbezeichnung, t.date_start,
           coalesce(t.netto_gebucht, 0)::numeric AS netto_gebucht
    FROM kursplan.v_kursart_termin t
    WHERE t.date_start >= timestamptz '2023-01-01 00:00:00 Europe/Berlin'
),
angebot_trainer AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT d.offer_id, dl.admin_id
    FROM edoobox_raw.offer_date d
    JOIN edoobox_raw.date_leader dl ON dl.date_id = d.date_id
    WHERE d.is_deleted = false
),
basis AS (
    SELECT p.*, z.admin_id, a.shortcut, a.is_active AS admin_aktiv,
           CASE
               WHEN z.admin_id IS NULL THEN 'offen'
               WHEN z.admin_id = 'admin_4c155f660347_225880320' THEN 'eigen'
               WHEN z.admin_id IN ('admin_802a0b62c8fa_230986090', 'admin_67d66851a4fb_399776305') THEN 'dummy'
               WHEN z.admin_id = 'admin_4fd8d3239e95_247330005' THEN 'administrativ'
               WHEN a.admin_id IS NULL THEN 'historisch_offen'
               ELSE 'fremd_offen'
           END::text AS kostenrolle,
           CASE
               WHEN z.admin_id IS NULL THEN '(ohne Trainer)'
               WHEN z.admin_id = 'admin_4c155f660347_225880320' THEN 'FW'
               WHEN z.admin_id = 'admin_802a0b62c8fa_230986090' THEN 'PP'
               WHEN z.admin_id = 'admin_67d66851a4fb_399776305' THEN 'Hansi Hansen'
               WHEN z.admin_id = 'admin_4fd8d3239e95_247330005' THEN 'PG'
               ELSE coalesce(nullif(a.shortcut, ''), z.admin_id)
           END::text AS trainer
    FROM produktiv p
    LEFT JOIN angebot_trainer z ON z.offer_id = p.offer_id
    LEFT JOIN edoobox_raw.trainer_admin a ON a.admin_id = z.admin_id AND a.is_deleted = false
),
trainer_gesamt AS (
    SELECT trainer, kostenrolle, admin_id, bool_or(admin_aktiv) AS admin_aktiv,
           count(DISTINCT offer_id) AS angebote,
           count(DISTINCT kurscode) AS kurscodes,
           round(sum(netto_gebucht), 2) AS netto_kontext,
           min(date_start) AS erster_einsatz, max(date_start) AS letzter_einsatz
    FROM basis
    GROUP BY trainer, kostenrolle, admin_id
),
trainer_kurs AS (
    SELECT trainer, kostenrolle, admin_id, bool_or(admin_aktiv) AS admin_aktiv,
           kurscode, min(kursbezeichnung) AS kursbezeichnung,
           count(DISTINCT offer_id) AS angebote,
           round(sum(netto_gebucht), 2) AS netto_kontext,
           min(date_start) AS erster_einsatz, max(date_start) AS letzter_einsatz
    FROM basis
    GROUP BY trainer, kostenrolle, admin_id, kurscode
),
kontrolle AS (
    SELECT count(*)::bigint AS angebote,
           count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT EXISTS (
               SELECT 1 FROM angebot_trainer at WHERE at.offer_id = p.offer_id
           ))::bigint AS ohne_trainer,
           count(*) FILTER (WHERE (
               SELECT count(*) FROM angebot_trainer at WHERE at.offer_id = p.offer_id
           ) > 1)::bigint AS mehrfachtrainer,
           count(*) FILTER (WHERE EXISTS (
               SELECT 1 FROM angebot_trainer at
               WHERE at.offer_id = p.offer_id
                 AND at.admin_id IN (
                     'admin_802a0b62c8fa_230986090',
                     'admin_67d66851a4fb_399776305',
                     'admin_4fd8d3239e95_247330005'
                 )
           ))::bigint AS dummy_oder_admin,
           round(sum(p.netto_gebucht), 2) AS netto
    FROM produktiv p
),
roh AS (
    SELECT 10 AS sort_bereich,
           'S56'::text AS schritt, 'A Trainerbestand'::text AS bereich,
           g.trainer, g.kostenrolle, g.admin_id, g.admin_aktiv,
           NULL::text AS kurscode, NULL::text AS kursbezeichnung,
           g.angebote, g.kurscodes, g.netto_kontext AS netto_ab_2023,
           g.erster_einsatz, g.letzter_einsatz,
           'Erloes ist bei Mehrfachtrainern nicht ueber Trainerzeilen addierbar'::text AS hinweis
    FROM trainer_gesamt g

    UNION ALL

    SELECT 20, 'S56', 'B Trainer x Kurscode',
           k.trainer, k.kostenrolle, k.admin_id, k.admin_aktiv,
           k.kurscode, k.kursbezeichnung, k.angebote, NULL::bigint,
           k.netto_kontext, k.erster_einsatz, k.letzter_einsatz,
           'Grundlage fuer trainer- und themenabhaengige Tarife'::text
    FROM trainer_kurs k

    UNION ALL

    SELECT 30, 'S56', 'C Kontrolle', '(gesamt)', 'kontrolle',
           NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, c.angebote, NULL::bigint, c.netto,
           NULL, NULL,
           concat('ohne Trainer ', c.ohne_trainer,
                  ' / Mehrfachtrainer ', c.mehrfachtrainer,
                  ' / Dummy oder administrativ ', c.dummy_oder_admin)
    FROM kontrolle c
)
SELECT schritt, bereich, trainer, kostenrolle, admin_id, admin_aktiv,
       kurscode, kursbezeichnung, angebote, kurscodes, netto_ab_2023,
       erster_einsatz, letzter_einsatz, hinweis
FROM roh
ORDER BY sort_bereich, kostenrolle, trainer, angebote DESC, kurscode NULLS FIRST;
